report.executiveSummary: During the incident window, Contoso Retail customers experienced degraded checkout and product catalogue performance (p99: 1650ms). Investigation evidence indicates the root cause is most likely associated with the active failure domain, specifically: Client-side p99 latency: 1650ms vs server-side Cosmos latency: 12ms — 1638ms gap indicates client/SDK or host overhead; SQL connection pool pressure: connections held beyond normal release; Azure Cosmos DB server-side latency: 12ms — within normal range, indicating service is healthy. Azure Cosmos DB service-side health remained nominal (server-side latency: 12ms). Azure SQL requires further validation. Immediate corrective actions are identified and safe to execute without service escalation.
report.engineeringRca: Telemetry shows p99 latency at 1650ms with 0 Cosmos 429 events, 65 RU/min consumption, host CPU 25%, and SQL latency 2100ms. The active toggles (sqlConnectionPressure) directly align with the observed failure signature. The client-to-server latency delta of 1638ms indicates most latency is introduced in the application, SDK, query design, or host execution path rather than inside the Azure Cosmos DB service plane.
